name: Aggressively Perfect Block
details: Deals 16 stabbing damage on a perfect block.
description: Perfect blocks deal damage and stun to attackers.

name: Battering Ram
details: Breaking an enemy's blocking stance with a charge attack increases the damage of all Smashing damage by 15% for 10 seconds.
description: Foes take extra smashing damage after breaking their guard for a short duration.

name: Burning Criticals
details: Increases the weapon's critical hit chance by 3% when the target's Sizzle is maxed out.
description: Critical hit chance is increased against burning foes.

name: Cheap Shot
details: Attacks deal 15% more damage to targets at full health.
description: Deal bonus damage against creatures with full health.

name: Charged Blastwave
details: Charged attacks emit an explosive AoE that deals 15 Spicy damage and 15 Sizzle buildup.
description: Charge attacks deal sizzle and spicy damage in an area.

name: Chilling Attack
details:
Glacial Sting & Ice Sickles:

Increases chill buildup by 20.

Mint Arrow & Great Mint Arrow:

Increases chill buildup by 20. Charged shots increase it by 30. Perfect shots increase it by 40.
description: Attacks cause foes to chill and freeze.

name: Critical Hit Chance
details: Critical hit chance is increased by 5%.
description: Attacks gain a chance to deal massive bonus damage.

name: Critical Hit: Venom
details: Critical hits increase venom buildup by 20.
description: Critical hits apply venom.

name: Desperate Criticals
details: Increases the players critical hit chance by 5% while they have 30% total health or less.
description: Critical hit chance is increased while you have low health.

name: Desperate Defense
details: Increases the damage reduction of all Armor by 25% while they have 30% total health or less.
description: Defense is increased while you have low health.

name: Finale Parry
details: The third hit of every combo increases the players parry window by 15 milliseconds for 10 seconds. Additionally, it gives a 25% damage boost after performing a perfect block for 10 seconds.
description: The final hit in your 3 hit combo slightly increases your perfect block window. Perfect blocking while this buff is active significantly increases damage on your next attack.

name: Finale Short Circuit
details: The third hit of every combo produces an electrical AoE explosion that deals 25 extra damage and 5 extra stun. Only applies to weapons with 3-hit combos.
description: The final hit in your 3 hit combo emits a large AoE shock.

name: Finale Warmth
details: The third hit of every combo reduces Chill buildup by 10. Only applies to weapons with 3-hit combos.
description: The final hit in a 3-hit combo reduces chill buildup.

name: Flyer Stun
details: Deals 50 stun to flying creatures.
description: Applies stun damage to target.

name: Gas Hazard
details: Deals 7 gas damage every second.
description: Gas damage over time.

name: Guard Breach
details: Breaking an enemies blocking stance deals 80 damage.
description: Charge attacks with dual sickles deal damage to foes in addition breaking their block.

name: Gaping Wound
details: Charge attacks reduce creatures resistance to all Stabbing damage by 10% for 10 seconds.
description: Charged attacks drive deeply and reduce stab resistance a short duration.

name: Greater Draw
details: Perfect shot window is 0.1 seconds shorter, but charged shots deal 15% more damage.
description: Charged shots deal additional damage but the perfect shot window is reduced.

name: Life Steal
details: Attacks heal 4% of damage dealt.
description: Heal when dealing damage.

name: Infection
details: Attacks apply a debuff that slows enemy attack speed and damage by 10%.
description: An internal infection slows attack speed and reduces attack damage.

name: Major Threat
details: Increases the player's favorability over other sources of aggression by 60%.
description: Increases enemies desire to attack you over other targets while in combat.

name: O.R.C. Bane
details: Deals 50 shock damage and 25 stun to O.R.C. creatures.
description: Attacks gain a large bonus to stun and damage against O.R.C. creatures.

name: Parry Buggie Heal
details: Perfect blocks heal nearby Buggies for 5% of their total health.
description: Perfect blocks heal buggies near you.

name: Reaping Blades
details: Killing an enemy instantly heals the player for 10% of their max health.
description: Heal a percentage of your max health when you kill things.

name: Soothing Sonata
details:
Bows have a 35% chance when hitting a target to give nearby players and Buggies a healing buff.
For players, it heals 0.5 health every 0.25 seconds for 10 seconds for a total of 20 health.
For Buggies, it heals 1.5 health every 0.25 seconds for 20 seconds for a total of 60 health.
description: A bardic tune is granting you HP regen.

name: Song of Discord
details: Each critical hit has a 35% chance to lower the targets attack by 15% for 10 seconds, a 35% chance to lower the targets movement speed by 40% for 5 seconds, and a 25% chance to apply 8 stun every second for 2 seconds.
description: Critical hits have a chance to apply random negative effects.

name: Sizzling Attack
details:
Burny Rounds:
 
Increases sizzle buildup by 20.

Scorching Orb:

Increases sizzle buildup by 25.

Spicy Arrow: & Great Spicy Arrow

Regular shots increase sizzle buildup by 20, charged shots increase sizzle buildup by 30, perfect shots increase sizzle buildup by 40.

Spicy Coaltana & Ash Maw:

Increases sizzle buildup by 10.
description: Attacks cause foes to sizzle and burn.

name: Slow
details:
Pollen Arrow:

Reduces creature movement speed by 50% for 10 seconds.

Sappy Rounds:

Reduces creature movement speed by 70% for 20 seconds.
description: Run slower.

name: Spicy Parry
details: Deals 15 spicy damage and adds 25 sizzle buildup on a perfect block.
description: Perfect blocks deal spicy damage and sizzle to attackers.

name: Sizzling Block
details: Causes all blocks to deal 7 Sizzle buildup and perfect blocks to deal an additional 18 Spicy damage.
description: Roast foes with sizzle when you block their attacks. In addition, perfect blocks deal bonus spicy damage.

name: Spider Criticals
details: Increases critical hit chance against all spider-type enemies by 5%.
description: Prolonged enmity with spiders has increased your critical hit chance against them

name: Stun
details: Deals 1 stun to creatures.
description: Applies stun damage to target.

name: Tang Attack
details:
Sour Katanga:

Increases Tang buildup by 10.

Sour Arrow & Great Sour Arrow:

Increases Tang buildup by 20. Charged shots increase it by 30. Perfect shots increase it by 40.

Acid Ruin & Wither Sting:

Increases Tang buildup by 35. Charged attacks deal 10 Tang buildup but leave an AoE that passively builds it.
description: Attacks weaken defenses so foes take more damage.

name: Tangy Parry
details: Perfect blocks deal 24 Sour damage and 10 Tang buildup.
description: Perfect blocks deal a burst of sour and apply tang to attackers.

name: Venom Attack
details:
Venom Arrow & Great Venom Arrow:

Increases venom buildup by 10. Charged shots increase it by 20. Perfect shots increase it by 30.

Axl's Talon & Wolfsbane Fangs:
 
Regular attacks increase venom buildup by 20, charged attacks and thrown attack increase venom buildup by 30.
description: Attacks buildup venom on hit, dealing damage over time.

name: Attack Damage
details: Increases damage dealt by 10%.
description: Attacks do more damage.

name: Attack Stamina: Ant
details: Decreases the attack stamina of all "red ant" weapons by 5.5%. These include the Crimson Saber, Larvalance, Mitey Claws, Red Ant Club, Crimson Avenger, and Gloom Skewer.
description: Your expertise in ant anatomy reduces the stamina cost of attacks with weapons made from red ant parts.

name: Bargain Block
details: Reduces the stamina cost of blocking by 12%.
description: Blocked attacks drain less stamina.

name: Block Stun
details: Blocking applies 1 stun to creatures.
description: Applies stun damage to target.

name: Bow Attack
details: Increases bow damage by 15%.
description: Attacks with bows do more damage.

name: Buggy Criticals
details: Increases the critical hit chance of the players Buggy. The Helm increases the chance by 9% and the Greaves and Vest increase the chance by 8%.
description: Your Buggy has increased critical hit chance.

name: Chill Reduction
details:
Fuzzy Armor & Mitey Muffs: Reduces Chill buildup by 50%.

Diving Suite Chestplate:  Reduces Chill buildup by 75%.
description: Slows the rate that the Chill shivers your timbers.

name: Critical Haste
details: Critical hits have a 50% chance to increase attack speed by 20% for 5 seconds. The buff on attack speed does not stack with multiple procs.
description: Critical hits with melee weapons have a chance to increase attack speed.

name: Critical Recovery
details: Healing another player or Buggy with Healbasas, Hearty Arrows, or the Cricket Lute Bow, increases the players critical hit chance by 50% for 5 seconds. Removes buff if they get a critical hit.
description: Healing effects bestowed to allies have a chance to greatly increase your critical hit chance for a short duration until you score a critical hit.

name: Diving Ballast
details: Prevents the player from swimming.
description: Counters buoyancy to help you sink with a diving suit. Prevents swimming but allows limited jumping underwater.

name: Double Deal
details: Attacks deal 5% more damage to creatures affected by venom.
description: Deal increased damage to enemies affected by venom.

name: Dual Dasher
details: Increases Dash Strike damage by 6.5%.
description: Dash strikes using dual wield weapons deal more damage.

name: Feeding Frenzy
details: Looting a corpse heals 3 health.
description: Restore health when looting corpses.

name: Finale Quickening
details: Increases the charge speed of candy staves by 15% if the charge is performed on the third hit of a three hit combo.
description: Staff charge attack speed when starting from the third hit in a combo is much faster.

name: Frosty Focus
details: Fresh damage is increased by 7.5% while the barrier from Parrier Barrier is active.
description: Fresh damage is increased while Parrier Barrier is active.

name: Hasty Riposte
details: Perfect blocks have a 50% chance to increase the charge time speed of melee weapons by 70% for 3 seconds
description: Perfect blocks have a chance to greatly increase melee charge attack speed for a short duration.

name: Lucky Break
details: Reduces the stamina used upon dodging by 10%.
description: Dodging uses less stamina.

name: Major Woozy Reduction
details: Reduces the buildup of Woozy by 90%.
description: Slows the rate of poison gas filling your lungs.

name: Master Diver
details: Reduces Oxygen drain by 90%.
description: Stay underwater for much longer before needing to surface.

name: Major Swim Speed
details: Increases swim speed by 40%.
description: Swim through water much faster.

name: Max Health
details: Increases max health by 10.
description: More max health.

name: More Better Draw
details: Increases Perfect Draw window by 35 milliseconds. Perfect Draw window is 300 milliseconds by default.

name: Opportunistic Parry

description: Perfect blocks have a chance to increase the stun of your next melee attack.

name: Parry Criticals
details: Perfect blocks have a 40% chance to increase critical hit chance by 1% for 15 seconds.
description: Perfect blocks have a chance to increase your critical hit chance for a short duration.

name: Parrier Barrier
details: Perfect Blocks activate a barrier that reduces taken damage by 7% until hit or combat ends, stacks 3 times.
description: Perfect blocks add a barrier that reduces damage. Stacks up to 3 times and is removed when hit or out of combat.

name: Parry Shock
details: Perfect blocks inflict 8 Shock damage and 1 stun.
description: Perfect blocks deal Shock damage and stun to the attacker.

name: Perfect Block Timing
details: Increases the player's perfect blocking timing window by 15 milliseconds.
description: Extends the perfect block timing window.

name: Perfect Quickdraw

description: Perfect bow shots have a chance to increase the charge speed of bows for a short duration.

name: Playful Pinch

description: Critical hit chance is increased against anything not "wearing" green!

name: Quickcharge

description: Charged attacks charge faster.

name: Sizzle Reduction

description: Slows the rate that the sizzle roasts you up.

description: Perfect blocks have a chance to release a splash of tangy goo.

name: Tangy Purification
details: Blocking attacks has a 20% chance to remove 20 Tang buildup.
description: Chance on block to reduce tang buildup.

name: The Quickness
details: Increases movement speed by 10%.
description: Run faster.

name: Venom Parry
details: Applies 10 Venom to the target on perfect parry.
description: Perfect parries apply Venom to the target.

name: Veteran Diver
details: Reduces Oxygen drain by 75%
description: Stay underwater for much longer before needing to surface.

description: Dash strikes using dual weapons inflict venom buildup on hit.

name: Water Chill Reduction
details: Reduces Chill buildup by 65%.
description: Chill buildup accumulates more slowly while underwater.

name: Woozy Reduction
details: Reduces the buildup of Woozy by 75%.
description: Slows the rate of poison gas filling your lungs.

name: Aphkid
details: Aphids ignore the player.
description: Aphids consider you one of their own and no longer flee from you.

name: Burn Resistance
details: Reduces Burning damage by 25%.
description: Reduces burn damage taken from the Sizzle.

name: Bowed Over

description: Fully charged bow shots deal additional stun damage.

name: Busting Power
details: Increases busting damage on resource nods by 25%.
description: Bust open pebbles in fewer hits.

name: Charged Shot Stamina
details: Charged and perfect bow shots consume 25% less stamina while the player has the buff from the armors piece effect, Perfect Quickdraw.
description: Charged and perfect bow shots consume less stamina while Perfect Quickdraw is triggered.

name: Crit Hyperstamina
details: Critical hits have a 50% chance to increase stamina regen by 20% for 20 seconds.
description: Critical hits increase your stamina regen for a short time.

name: Critical Inspiration
details: Critical hits increase nearby Buggies attack speed by 15% for 10 seconds.

name: Critical Opportunity

description: Attacks buffed by Opportunistic Parry have increased critical hit chance.

name: Dash Damage

description: The next attack after an underwater dash deals increased damage.

name: Dash Stamina

description: Underwater dodges consume less stamina.

description: The timing window for perfect dash strikes with Dual Wield weapons is increased.

name: Draw Breath
details: Perfect shots from Bows and Greatbows cost 50% less stamina.
description: Perfectly charged bow shotsrefund stamina.

name: Emergency Repair
details: Blocking attacks restores durability.
description: Blocking attacks helps maintain armor durability.

name: Empowered Devastation
details: The third hit of every combo with a staff has a 25% chance to give an extra stack for the Serpent Armors set bonus, Devastation.
description: Finale attacks with staves have a chance to generate an additional devastation stack.

name: Explosive Resist
details: Increases resistance to Explosive damage by 50%.
description: Increases your resistance to taking damage.

name: Fatal Frenzy
details: Killing creatures restores 15 stamina.
description: Melee kills restore stamina.

name: Final Mash
details: The third hit of every combo deals 3 extra Smashing damage.
description: The final hit in a 3-hit combo deals bonus smashing damage.

name: Fleet Creep
details: Increases movement speed when crouching by 12%.
description: You have thighs of thunder and knees of steel. Move faster while crouching.

name: Freeze Resistance
details: Reduces the damage of being Frozen by 25%.
description: Reduces damage taken when frozen.

name: Guard Breaker
details: Breaking an enemies blocking stance with a charged attack deal 3 extra stun.
description: Deal additional stun to foes when you break their guard.

name: Hyperstamina
details:
Grub Armor & Mitey Muffs:
 
Increases stamina regeneration rate by 10%.	

Wolf Armor:
 
Increases stamina regeneration rate by 15%.
description: Regain stamina faster.

name: Increased Healing
details: Increases the amount of health received from any healing options by 12%.
description: Increases the amount of healing you receive from all sources.

name: Loot Luck
details: Increases the drop rates of loot from creatures by 10%.
description: More likely to obtain rare resources from creatures.

name: Minor Threat
details: Decreases creatures favorability of the player over other sources of aggression by 10%.
description: Decreases enemies desire to attack you over other targets while in combat.

name: Omophagia
details: Reduces Sickness damage by 40%.
description: You take less damage from sickness when eating raw food.

name: Shock Resistance
details: Increases resistance to Shock damage by 9%.
description: Reduces damage taken from Shock attacks.

name: Spicy Attack
details: Increases all Spicy damage dealt by 5%.
description: Increases spicy damage delt.

description: Reduces damage from slashing attacks.

name: Tang Reduction
details: Reduces the rate of Tang buildup by 50%.
description: Slows the rate tang weakens defenses.

name: Trickle Regen
details: Regenerates 0.35 of the players health every 5 seconds.
description: Regenerate health over time.

name: Venomous Ambush
details: Ambush attacks inflict 10 Venom buildup.
description: Deal venom to creatures you ambush.

name: Venom Reduction
details: Reduces the rate of Venom buildup by 25%.
description: Slows the rate of venom seeping through your body.

name: Adaptive Resistance
details: Any damage delt by Chilling, Sizzle, or Venom damage will give the player a 6.8% damage reduction buff against the effect that harmed them. Stacks up to 5 times per unique buildup effect and lasts till the buildup effect expires.
description: Gain damage resistance against Venom, Chill or Sizzle, stacks up to five times. Added resistance is removed when negative effects expire.

name: Apex Pollinator
details: Perfect shots spawn a pollen cloud that deals 5 stun and slows enemies by 50%.
description: Perfectly charged bow shots release a cloud of pollen that slows targets.

name: Barmy Buccaneer
details: Attacks with Swords increase damage by 5%. Stacks up to 3 times and resets upon being hit or when combat ends. Does NOT reset when switching to another weapon.
description: Sword attacks increase damage for a short duration, stacking up to 3 times.

name: Bubble Struggle
details: Gives spear attacks against underwater creatures a 20% chance to increase Oxygen by 5.
description: Spear attacks against underwater creatures can restore Oxygen.

name: Chilly Dodge
details: The third hit of stave combos gives an effect that causes the players next dodge to emit an AoE that deals 50 Fresh damage and 20 Chill buildup.
description: Staff finisher hits give your body power for a short time. Blast foes with a gust of chilling wind when you dodge.

name: Crippling Strike
details: Ambush attacks entirely immobilize the target for 2 seconds.
description: Angry creatures you ambush with melee weapons are immobilized a short duration.

name: Critical Momentum
details: Melee attacks increase critical hit chance by 1%, stacking 5 times until the player either lands a critical hit or combat ends.
description: Successful attacks increase critical hit chance, stacking up to 5 times. Lose stacks when hit or combat ends.

name: Deadly Venom
details: Melee attacks have a 35% chance to cause enemies to take 20% more damage from Venom for 5 seconds.
description: Melee hits might increase venom damage for a short duration.

name: Devastation
details: Staves third hit in a three hit combo gives a buff to the player. These buffs stack up to 5 times. The next charge attacks damage will be buffed by 15% for each stack of buff.
description: Staff finale attacks generate a devastation stack, up to 5 times. Your next staff charge attack consumes stacks to amplify damage.

name: Dreadful Duo
details: Critical hits from the player deal 10 Venom buildup and an instantaneous 25 Venom damage. Buggy critical hits deal the same instantaneous damage but deal 30 Venom buildup instead.
description: Critical hits dealt by you or your Buggy inject venom and erupt in a burst of extra damage.

name: Exertion
details: Killing creatures reduces Chill buildup by 10.
description: Kills reduce Chill buildup.

name: Finale Force
details: Causes the third hit of a three hit combo with melee weapons to increase the damage of combo finishers by 8%. This stacks up to 5 times and resets upon being hit.
description: The third hit of a three hit combo increases combo finisher damage. This effect stacks up to five times and resets when hit.

name: Formic Retort
details: Perfect blocks add 15 Sour damage and 10 Tang buildup to the next attack. This buff stacks 3 times and is removed upon performing the empowered attack.
description: Perfect blocks imbue your next melee attack with acid damage, stacking up to three times.

name: Hardy Defense
details: Increases damage reduction by 5% while blocking attacks.
description: Increased damage resistance while blocking.

name: Healthy Harmony
details: Perfect shots increases the players healing from all sources by 20% for 15 seconds.
description: Perfect bow shots increase the amount of healing you and allies receive from all sources for a short duration.

name: Lone Ranger
details: Increases damage of all Bows and Spears by 10%.
description: Increased attack damage with bows and spears.

name: Moist
details: Reduces thirst drain by 50%.
description: You're absorbent and porous and retain water very well.

name: Perfect Combo
details: Perfect shots with Bows or Greatbows give a stacking buff. This buff stacks up to 5 times. The damage of the next charged or uncharged shot preformed will be increased by 10% for each stack of the buff.
description: Perfect bow shots increase damage until you fire a regular or charged shot, stacking up to 5 times.

name: Power Surge
details: Perfect blocks have a 3% chance to trigger a Power Surge that deals 60 Shock damage and 15 stun. Each perfect block increases the chance by 3%. The chance resets when Power Surge triggers or combat ends.
description: Perfect blocks build up a chance to unleash a powerful Shock attack.

name: Puck Luck
details: Increases the players critical hit damage by 20% if the targets Tang buildup is maxed.
description: Deal more critical hit damage against puckered foes.

name: Retaliation
details: Blocking attacks causes your next charge attack to emit an AoE that deals 30 Smashing damage and 10 stun. Blocking extra attacks while this effect is active will buff the AoE, increasing its damage by 20% and the players charge attack speed by 5%. These buffs stack 5 times and are removed when a charge attack is preformed or when leaving combat.
description: Blocked hits give your next charged melee a shockwave. Retaliation stacks up to 5 times, increasing charge attack speed and damage.

name: Scarlet Embrace
details: Blocking attacks applies a healing effect that restores 0.25 health every 0.5 seconds over 3 seconds.
description: Blocked attacks restore health slightly.

name: Searing Strikes
details: increases the player's damage by 10% if the target has any Sizzle buildup. If the target's Sizzle buildup is maxed, it increases the player's damage by another 9%.
description: Deal increased damage to sizzling foes. Damage is further increased if they are burning.

name: Spud Bud
details: Perfect blocks give a 15% damage reduction to all nearby players for 15 seconds.
description: You and nearby allies gain defense after perfect blocking an attack for a short duration.

name: Strength in Numbers
details: Increases the attack damage of the user and all nearby allies by 6.5%. Nearby allies count as other players or Buggies. Stacks up to 3 times.
description: Nearby allies enhance attack power, stacking up to 3 times.

name: Swarm Crusher
details: Gives a 6.5% attack boost for every creature within 10 centimeters of the player. Stacks up to 3 times.
description: Melee damage increases by the number of foes surrounding you.

name: Under Pressure
details: Provides unlimited Oxigen, immunity to underwater Chill, and the ability to explore The Abyss region.
description: Remain protected from the effects of extreme cold underwater.

name: Whizzy Wizard
details: Damage from staves increase the players attack speed by 3%. Stacks 5 times until hit or when combat ends.
description: Staff hits increase the speed of your attacks, stacking up to 5 times. The effect resets when hit or when combat ends.

name: Attack Stamina
details: Decreases stamina used while attacking by 10%.
description: Attacking uses less stamina.

name: Bandaged
details:
Fiber Bandage:

Heals 1.25 health every 0.25 seconds over a period of 10 seconds for a total of 50 health.

Blueberry Bandage:

Heals 1.75 health every 0.25 seconds over a period of 10 seconds for a total of 70 health.

Lingonberry Bandage & Chrysalis Bandage:

Heals 2.25 health every 0.25 seconds over a period of 10 seconds for a total of 90 health.
description: Recover health over time. Effect cancelled by taking damage.

name: Brain Freeze

description: You can eat ice if thirsty... but you might regret it.

Reduces the amount of sizzle buildup by 60 and the rate at which sizzle builds up by 99% for 3 seconds.

Mint Shard:

Reduces the amount of sizzle buildup by 40 and the rate at which sizzle builds up by 99% for 3 seconds.
description: Greatly slows the rate at which the Chill shivers your timbers.

name: Cooling Gel

description: Recover from Sizzle buildup and prevent burning damage for a short duration.

name: Damage Resist
details:
Beefy Human Food:

Reduces damage taken by 15%.

Cheese 'n' Fries & Human Food:

Reduces damage taken by 10%.
description: Increases your resistance to taking damage.

Reduces fall damage taken by 50%.

Fall Feast:

Reduces fall damage taken by 90%.

description: Prevents damage from all gas-based attacks and effects.

Increases the amount of hauling items that can be carried at once by 5.

Worker's Comp:

Increases the amount of hauling items that can be carried at once by 3.

details:

Increases max stamina by 30.

Boost Juice:

Increases max stamina by 20.

Fall Feast:

Increases max stamina by 15.
description: More max stamina.

description: Instantly reduce the amount of accumulated Venom.

Reduces the damage taken from Venom by 25%.

Wasperole:

Reduces the damage taken from Venom by 30%.

name: Burning Brand
details: Charged attacks decrease the target's resistance to Burning damage by 200% for 10 seconds.
description: Charged attacks apply burn vulnerability, greatly reducing a foe's resistance to burning damage for a short time.

name: Candy Overload
details: Attacks with candy staves increase the damage of the specific Augment that is being used by 5. Stacks up to 5 times for a total of 25 extra damage per Augment and lasts until combat ends.
description: Staff attacks increase flat damage to their corresponding candy element, stacking up to 5 times until you change weapons or exit combat.

name: Charged Shot Damage
details: Increases the damage of charged bow shots by 10%.
description: Fully charged bow shots deal more damage.

name: Chilly Charge
details: All charged attacks to emit an AOE effect that deals 25 fresh damage and increases enemy's chill buildup by 40.
description: Melee charge attacks cause foes to chill and freeze.

name: Death's Door
details: Gives a 25% boost in crit chance when creature the player is trying to damage is below 30% health. It only works with only 2-handed weapons, with the exceptions being the Roach Club and Ash Maw.
description: Critical hit chance is greatly increased with two-handed weapons against creatures with low health.

name: Finale Blastwave
details: Third hits in a combo to emit an AOE effect that deals 15 spicy damage and increases an enemy's sizzle build-up by 15.
description: The final hit in a 3-hit combo emits a sizzling blastwave.

name: Finale Venom
details: Causes all third hits in a three hit combo to deal 30 venom build-up and deal 10 stabbing damage to all creatures.
description: The final hit in a 3-hit combo with melee weapons adds venom.

name: Food Generation
details: Provides 10 passive food generation every 60 seconds.
description: Your hunger is filling up over time without the need to eat.

name: Fresh Attack
details: Applies a flat 15 Fresh damage to the player's attacks.
description: Adds a flat amount of fresh damage to all your attacks.

name: Friendly Fire Defense Up
details: Increases the defense against friendly fire by 50%.
description: Reduces the amount of friendly fire damage you receive from fellow teens.

name: Haywire
details: Charged attacks with melee weapons against O.R.C. Creatures create a shockwave that deals 50 damage. Charged attacks with melee weapons (except for sickles) deal 25 shock damage and 15 chopping damage to all creatures, although there is no visual effect.
description: Charge attack hits again O.R.C. creatures overloads their receivers, unleashing a shocking blast around them.

name: Low Health: Attack Up
details: Increases the player's damage by 15% for 15 seconds when the player's health is below 30%.
description: Increases damage dealt with attacks when hit while you have low health.

name: Lucky Flurry
details: All attacks to have a 7% chance to boost the players critical hit chance by 25% for 3 seconds. Triggering the effect multiple times will not stack the buff, instead refreshing its timer.
description: Attacks have a chance to greatly boost critical hit chance for a short duration.

name: O.R.C. Attack Down
details: Attacks decrease the damage that O.R.C. creatures deal by 20% for 5 seconds.
description: Attack hits reduce damage dealt by O.R.C. creatures for a short duration.

name: Quickdraw
details: Reduces the time it takes to charge up bow attacks by 15%.
description: You can charge bow shots faster.

name: Raging Venom
details: Critical hits inflict a DoT effect that deals 2 Venom damage every 0.5 seconds for 10 seconds. Critical hits also inflict 20 Venom buildup and decrease resistance to all Venom damage by 50% for 10 seconds.
description: Critical hits apply venom that persists, increasing venom damage taken for a short duration.

name: Shock Attack
details: Adds 10 flat shock damage on top of all melee attacks.
description: Adds a flat amount of shock damage to all your melee attacks.

name: Sizzle Finale
details: Third hits in a combo inflict 10 Sizzle buildup.
description: The final hit in a 3-hit combo rains sizzle upon your foes.

name: Sour Attack
details: Applies a flat 15 Sour damage to the player's attacks.
description: Adds a flat amount of sour damage to all your attacks.

name: Vampirism
details: Restores 8 health for every creature killed.
description: Heals you when you kill things

name: Ambush
details: Ambush attacks have a 100% critical hit chance.
description: Deal critical hits against creatures unaware of your presence.

name: Assassin
details: Daggers and Sickles deal 10%/15%/20% more critical hit damage. Dash Strikes have 5%/8%/10% more critical hit chance.
description: Dash strikes have increased critical hit chance. Dual daggers and sickles deal increased damage on critical hits.

name: Blademaster
details: Sword attacks cause creatures to deal 10%/20%/30% less damage for 5 seconds.
description: Sword attacks lower damage inflicted by enemies for a short duration.

name: Bow Master
details: Perfectly charged bow shot damage is increased by 10%.
description: Perfectly charged bow shots deal more damage.

name: Buggy Threat
details: When landing a perfect shot with a bow or a greatbow, nearby Buggies will be targeted 100% more often in combat for 15 seconds.
description: Buggies will greatly draw ire from foes while enraged by pheromone shot.

name: Cloak and Dagger
details: Ambush attacks give 50%/80%/100% more critical hit damage when using daggers.
description: Ambush attacks with daggers greatly increase critical hit damage.

name: Club Master
details: Clubs deal 25% more damage against stunned creatures.
description: Club attacks deal more damage against stunned creatures.

name: Dagger Master
details: Kills with daggers and sickles give 5% more critical hit chance for 5 seconds.
description: Kills with daggers and sickles increase critical hit chance for a short duration.

name: Defender: Attack Up
details: Increases damage against wave creatures by 10%/25%/50%.
description: Increases damage dealt to creatures that are attacking your turf.

name: Exhaustion
details: Decreases the exhaustion timer by 10%/20%/30%.
description: Lowers the amount of time you spend exhausted after using all of your stamina.

name: Fist Master
details: Every unarmed hit deals an extra attack that deals 1 smashing damage and 2 stun.
description: Fist attacks deal bonus stun and generate two stacks on hit.

name: Frenzy
details: Attacks deal 20% more damage for 5 seconds. Removes the ability to perfect block for 5 seconds. Every attacks grant an effect that heals 1 health every 1 second for 5 seconds.
description: Melee attacks trigger rage. You deal increased damage and regenerate health while enraged but cannot time your blocks.

name: Gas Resistance
details: Reduces gas damage by 25%/40%/50%.
description: Reduces damage taken from poison gas.

name: Javelineer
details: After hitting a creature with a spear, the **Thorns** effect is temporarily applied to the player for 5 seconds. During which, 100%/150%/200% of all damage to the player will be reflected back to the attacker. Thrown spear attacks deal 10%/20%/30% more damage.
description: Spears deal more damage when thrown, and some damage dealt to you bounces on your attacker.

name: Lil Fist
details: Every unarmed hit increases unarmed charged attack damage by 5%/7.5%/10% until the player gets hit or combat ends, stacks 15 times.
description: On hit, fist attacks add a stack towards a charged attack. Charged attacks unleash all stacks for a devastating blow!

name: Parry Master
details: Grants perfect blocks a 100% chance to give 20/25/30 stamina.
description: Perfect blocks restore stamina.

name: Pheromone Shot
details: When landing a perfect shot with a bow or a greatbow, nearby Buggies will deal 35% more damage for 15 seconds.
description: Perfect bow shots enrage nearby Buggies, dealing bonus damage for a short duration.

name: Revive Speed
details: Increases revive speed by 25%/40%/50%.
description: Revive your downed friends faster.

name: Sharpshooter
details: Charged bow shot critical hit chance is increased by 5%/8%/10%.
description: Fully charged bow shots gain additional critical hit chance.

name: Shatter Resistance
details: Reduces frozen shatter damage taken by 25%.
description: Reduces shatter damage when hit while frozen.

name: Smasher
details: Clubs deal 1/2/3 extra stun per hit.
description: Attacks with clubs deal more stun.

name: Spear Master
details: Charged attacks with spears deal 30% more damage.
description: Charged attacks with spears deal additional damage.

name: Staff Master
details: Increases critical hit chance by 5% against burning and frozen creatures.
description: Critical hit chance with staff attacks is increased on frozen and burning foes with max buildup.

name: Sword Master
details: Attacking creatures with a sword reduces the exhaustion timer by 90%.
description: Attacking creatures with a sword temporarily removes your stamina timer.

name: Whittle Wizard
details: Staff attacks cause frozen creatures to take 50%/75%/100% more frozen shatter damage for 100 seconds. Staff attacks cause burning creatures to take 50%/75%/100% more burning damage for 5 seconds. Attacks from sour staves increases damage you deal on all creatures by 5%/10%/15% for 5 seconds
description: Staff attacks are enhanced by elemental effects. Sizzle burns with greater intensity. Frozen foes that shatter take more damage. Puckered foes take more damage.

name: Yoked Blows
details: Increases critical hit damage by 20%/40%/60%.
description: Increases the damage multiplier of critical hits.

name: Comfy Defense
details: Reduces all damage taken by 10%.
description: Sleeping in a luxurious spot grants an all-day bonus to defense.

name: Comfy Energy
details: Reduces stamina exhaustion recovery rate by 10%.
description: Sleeping in a luxurious spot grants an all-day bonus to exhaustion time.

name: Comfy Hunger
details: Reduces hunger rate by 10%.
description: Sleeping in a comfy spot grants an all-day bonus to hunger fullness.

name: Comfy Thirst
details: Reduces thirst rate by 10%.
description: Sleeping in a comfy spot grants an all-day bonus to thirst saturation.

name: Relaxed
details:
Normal Chair, Pine Chair, & Pine Stool:

Reduces the rate at which hunger and thirst drain by 25%.

Blueberry Chair & Pine Lounger:

Reduces the rate at which hunger and thirst drain by 50%.

Tarantula Throne:

Reduces the rate at which hunger and thirst drain by 75%.
description: Lounging in a comfy chair slows your hunger and thirst rates.

name: Damage Resist Down
details: Increases damage taken by 25%.
description: Reduces your resistance to taking damage.

name: Sick
details:
Raw Meat & Rotten Food:

Deals 7.5 poison damage every 3 seconds for 15 seconds.

Spoiled Meat:

Deals 12.5 poison damage every 3 seconds for 15 seconds.
description: Deals damage over time.

name: Arachnophobia
details: Decreases damage dealt to spiders by 50%.
description: Frozen in fear, you deal less damage against spiders.

name: Shivering
details: Increases hunger drain rate by 100%.
description: Get hungry faster.
sources: Being inside the Ice Cream Cart
Being inside the Picnic Fridge Cooler

name: Sweaty
details: Increases thirst drain rate by 100%.
description: Get thirsty faster.

name: Incognito
details: Prevents the player from building up any "heat" from messing with the Masked Stranger's stuff, entirely negating O.R.C. Waves from spawning.
description: Hides your meddling from the Masked Stranger.

name: Shock Therapy
details: Increases all player dealt Shock damage by 10%, but also causes the player to take 10% more damage from Shock damage.
description: Deal more Shock damage, but take more too.

name: Junior Diver
details: Reduces Oxygen drain by 50%.
description: Breathe underwater for longer.

name: Swim Speed
details: Increases the player's swim speed by 30%.
description: Swim faster.

name: Sprint Stamina
details: Reduces the stamina cost of sprinting by 10%.
description: Sprinting costs less stamina.
